meta.title: The Box
meta.description: A girl tries to understand why her cat is obsessed with an empty box

script.line: I spent two hundred dollars on that cat tree.
You're sitting in the box it came in!
Cardboard that perfectly contains my essence.
When I'm in the box, I know exactly where I end and the world begins.
Fine. Keep your box. I'm returning the cat tree.
Ooh! Will the next one come in a bigger box?
